instructions: This paper consists of sections A, B and C with a total of ten (10) questions.
Answer all questions in the spaces provided.
Section A carries fifteen (15) marks, section B carries seventy (70) marks, and section C carries fifteen (15) marks.
All writing must be in blue or black ink except drawings which must be in pencil.
Cellular phones and any unauthorized materials are not allowed in the assessment room.
Non-programmable calculators may be used where necessary.
Write your Assessment Number at the top right corner of every page.
The following atomic masses may be used: H = 1, C = 12, N = 14, O = 16, Na = 23, S = 32, Cl = 35.5.
